scenarios.name: owned_cdp_reconnect_and_explicit_restart
scenarios.title: Approve once, reconnect the same page, submit once, then explicitly restart
scenarios.workflow: Start headless -> login -> user approval -> disconnect -> reconnect -> submit -> restart -> reject stale session
scenarios.user_problem: An agent must preserve page/login identity and avoid duplicate server actions while recovering control; restart must be separate.

scenarios.name: real_extension_installed_profile_start_disconnect_reconnect
scenarios.title: Launch a persistently installed extension profile without loading flags or a CDP port
scenarios.workflow: Persist login/installed extension -> explicit extension launch -> approve -> disconnect -> reconnect same tab/profile -> submit -> owned close
scenarios.user_problem: Reuse the real profile's authenticated browser state and release/recover control without repeating a server submission.

scenarios.name: real_extension_existing_chrome_preserves_user_tabs
scenarios.title: Connect an existing Chrome and continue a user's trusted action in the same automation tab
scenarios.workflow: Existing logged-in Chrome -> connect -> human-side UI approval -> reject unauthorized restart -> reconnect -> submit -> disconnect -> inspect sentinel
scenarios.user_problem: Connecting and recovering must preserve browser PID/profile, the dedicated page and unrelated user tabs.

scenarios.name: unsupported_modes_do_not_launch_or_replay
scenarios.title: Explain missing extension and unsupported attached headless without substituting a browser
scenarios.workflow: Discover help -> request unavailable profile -> inspect unsupported -> start correct CDP -> reject mode mutation -> approve once -> verify no duplicate
scenarios.user_problem: A model needs accurate failure reasons and an explicit recovery decision, never an implicit transport/profile switch.

scenarios.name: real_extension_worker_recovery_with_oauth_child
scenarios.title: Keep profile/session and OAuth child across a worker interruption
scenarios.workflow: Login -> trusted popup open -> stop/start worker -> same session -> trusted consent -> close owned child -> observe parent server state
scenarios.user_problem: An extension worker must recover the same parent and OAuth tab without losing profile identity or replaying consent.

scenarios.name: real_extension_delayed_handshake_preserves_ownership
scenarios.title: Recover control after an explicit launch outlasts its handshake deadline
scenarios.workflow: Configured profile -> launch with zero wait -> retain PID -> connect same launched process -> authenticated approval -> submit once -> owned close
scenarios.user_problem: A slow handshake must preserve the real browser and its recorded ownership without launching a second process.
